lines.en: Good morning, Tom. Did you have a good night's sleep? I heard you go downstairs last night.
lines.zh: 早上好，汤姆。昨晚睡得好吗？我昨晚听到你下楼了。

lines.en: Oh, no, actually, I didn't sleep well. I drank too much at the party last night. I felt sick and went to the bathroom in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: 哦，不，实际上我睡得并不好。昨晚的聚会上，我喝了太多酒。半夜感觉不舒服，所以去了洗手间。

lines.en: That's too bad. Are you OK now?
lines.zh: 真可怜。你现在好些了吗？

lines.en: Except a terrible hangover.
Why don't you take stomach medicine?
lines.zh: 你为什么不吃点胃药呢？

lines.en: Yeah, I will. Where is the medicine chest?
lines.zh: 是啊，我得吃点。药箱在哪儿呢？

lines.en: In the closet in our bedroom.
lines.zh: 在我们卧室的衣橱里面。

lines.en: OK. Thank you.

Where?
On your cheek. Let me wipe it off.
Oh, it's ketchup.
Haha, be careful next time.
Thanks for telling me.

lines.en: (knocking on the bathroom door) Is someone in here?
Yeah, daddy. I'm drying off so don't even try to open the door.
lines.zh: 有人，爸爸。我在擦身子呢，千万别开门。

lines.en: Oh, OK. How long will it take?
lines.zh: 哦，好的。你得要多长时间？

lines.en: Well, maybe 30 minutes.
30 minutes? Why so long?
lines.zh: 30 分钟？为什么要那么长时间？

lines.en: I have a big date today and I need to style my hair and put on makeup.
lines.zh: 我今天有个很重要的约会，所以我得给头发做造型，还得化妆。

lines.en: A big date? You're too young. Anyway, I want to use the toilet. Get out right now!!
lines.zh: 重要约会？你还太小了。总之，我得用洗手间。马上给我出来！

lines.en: OK, OK. I'm coming. Wait a minute!
lines.zh: 好吧，好吧。来了。等一小会儿！

phrases.example: Why don't you put butter on your bread? It would taste better that way.
phrases.example_zh: 你为什么不在面包上抹点黄油呢？那样味道会更好。

lines.en: Breakfast is ready. Come sit down.
lines.zh: 早餐准备好了。过来坐吧。

lines.en: Morning, mom. It looks tasty but I'm not hungry right now.
lines.zh: 早上好，妈妈。早餐看起来真的很美味，但我现在一点都不饿。

lines.en: Well, you should eat breakfast. Only a little bite.
lines.zh: 你得吃早饭。只吃一点也行。

lines.en: OK. I'll eat just a little cereal and... what's this?
lines.zh: 好吧，我就喝一点麦片粥和……这是什么？

lines.en: It's vegetable soup. You can eat it.
Yeah, I'll have this, too. Can you pour milk in my cereal?
lines.zh: 好，我也要喝点蔬菜汤。你能往我的麦片粥里倒些牛奶吗？

lines.en: Sure. I'll make coffee, would you like some?
lines.zh: 当然。我要煮咖啡，你要喝点吗？

lines.en: No thanks. Strong coffee is not good for my stomach.
lines.zh: 不了，谢谢。浓咖啡对我的胃没有好处。

phrases.example: The hotel offers a continental breakfast.
phrases.example_zh: 酒店提供欧式早餐。

phrases.example: An English breakfast includes eggs and beans.
phrases.example_zh: 英式早餐包括鸡蛋和豆子。

phrases.example: We had a Japanese-style breakfast with miso soup.
phrases.example_zh: 我们吃了日式早餐，有味噌汤。

phrases.example: Natto is made from fermented soybeans.
phrases.example_zh: 纳豆是用发酵大豆做的。

phrases.example: She served a bowl of rice to each guest.
phrases.example_zh: 她给每位客人盛了一碗米饭。

phrases.example: Steamed rice goes well with the dish.
phrases.example_zh: 蒸米饭配这道菜很好。

phrases.example: He sprinkled dried seaweed on the rice.
phrases.example_zh: 他在米饭上撒了干海带。

phrases.example: He finished the rice in his bowl.
phrases.example_zh: 他吃完了碗里的饭。

phrases.example: Use chopsticks to eat noodles.
phrases.example_zh: 用筷子吃面。

phrases.example: Miso soup is a Japanese staple.
phrases.example_zh: 味噌汤是日本餐桌上的主食。

phrases.example: They had dried fish for breakfast.
phrases.example_zh: 他们早餐吃了鱼干。

phrases.example: Dip the sushi in soy sauce.
phrases.example_zh: 把寿司蘸点酱油。

phrases.example: Some people eat raw egg over rice.
phrases.example_zh: 有人喜欢在米饭上打生鸡蛋吃。

phrases.example: She made a rolled egg for dinner.
phrases.example_zh: 她做了鸡蛋卷当晚饭。

phrases.example: Grated radish goes with tempura.
phrases.example_zh: 萝卜泥配天妇罗吃。

phrases.example: She ate pickles with rice.
phrases.example_zh: 她就着咸菜吃饭。

phrases.example: Pickled plum adds a sour taste.
phrases.example_zh: 腌酸梅带点酸味。

phrases.example: He ate rice porridge when he was sick.
phrases.example_zh: 他生病时喝了稀饭。

phrases.example: Which do you like, omelets or fried eggs?
phrases.example_zh: 你喜欢哪一种，炒鸡蛋还是煎鸡蛋？

phrases.example: I can't eat this soup. It's a little too hot.
phrases.example_zh: 我喝不来这种汤。有点太辣了。

phrases.example: I don't like fermented soybeans. The smell is awful.
phrases.example_zh: 我不喜欢豆酱。太难闻了。

phrases.example: Wow, these bacon and eggs are very spicy. Can I get water, please?
phrases.example_zh: 哇，这些咸肉煎蛋太辣了。能给我点水吗？

phrases.example: Mmm, I love the aroma of this coffee.
phrases.example_zh: 嗯，我喜欢这种咖啡的香味。

dialogues.title: 情景对话 · 鸡蛋早餐

lines.en: How would you like your eggs?
Scrambled, please.
With toast?
Yes, and a glass of orange juice.
Coming right up.
Yum, thank you!

phrases.example: Do you want soda or water?
phrases.example_zh: 你要苏打水还是白水？

phrases.example: Would you like a cup of tea?
phrases.example_zh: 来杯茶好吗？

phrases.example: I drink coffee every morning.
phrases.example_zh: 我每天早晨都喝咖啡。

phrases.example: The coffee maker is broken.
phrases.example_zh: 咖啡机坏了。

phrases.example: I'll make some coffee.
phrases.example_zh: 我来煮点咖啡。

phrases.example: Soft drinks are sugary beverages.
phrases.example_zh: 软饮料是含糖饮品。

phrases.example: The baby drinks warm milk before bed.
phrases.example_zh: 宝宝睡前喝温牛奶。

phrases.example: Limit soft drinks for your teeth.
phrases.example_zh: 为了牙齿少喝软饮料。

phrases.example: Orange juice is rich in vitamin C.
phrases.example_zh: 橙汁富含维生素 C。

phrases.example: I like strong coffee in the morning.
phrases.example_zh: 早上我喜欢浓咖啡。

phrases.example: She only drinks decaf at night.
phrases.example_zh: 她晚上只喝无咖啡因咖啡。

phrases.example: He poured coffee into his cup.
phrases.example_zh: 他把咖啡倒进杯子里。

phrases.example: Let's clear the table after dinner.
phrases.example_zh: 饭后我们把桌子收拾了。

phrases.example: Please clear the table.
phrases.example_zh: 请把餐桌收拾一下。

phrases.example: He rolled up his sleeves to wash dishes.
phrases.example_zh: 他卷起袖子洗碗。

phrases.example: I'll wash the dishes tonight.
phrases.example_zh: 今晚我来洗碗。

phrases.example: Stack the dirty dishes in the sink.
phrases.example_zh: 把脏餐具摞在水槽里。

phrases.example: Wipe it with a sponge.
phrases.example_zh: 用海绵擦一下。

phrases.example: Add some dish detergent to the water.
phrases.example_zh: 在水里加点洗洁精。

phrases.example: She dried the plates with a dishcloth.
phrases.example_zh: 她用洗碗布把盘子擦干。

phrases.example: Use a scouring pad for the pan.
phrases.example_zh: 用钢丝绒刷锅。

phrases.example: Load the dishwasher after dinner.
phrases.example_zh: 饭后把碗放进洗碗机。

phrases.example: What would you like to have as a breakfast beverage?
phrases.example_zh: 早餐你想喝什么饮料？

phrases.example: Can I have a decaf coffee? I often can't sleep after drinking regular coffee.
phrases.example_zh: 我能要一杯低卡咖啡吗？喝完普通咖啡后，我经常睡不着。

phrases.example: You should roll up your sleeves before washing dishes.
phrases.example_zh: 洗碗之前，你应该卷起袖子。

phrases.example: Use a scouring brush and dish detergent for grease on the pan.
phrases.example_zh: 用擦洗用的刷子和餐具洗涤剂清洗盘子上的油污。

phrases.example: After I wash the dishes, will you dry them with the dishcloth?
phrases.example_zh: 我洗完餐具之后，你能用洗碗布把它们擦干吗？

lines.en: Taste this soup. Is it salty enough?
It needs a little more salt.
How about the sweetness?
It's just right.
Great, let's eat.
I'm so hungry!

chapters.chapter: Chapter 2 On the Way to the Office or School 去办公室/学校的路上

scenes.scene: Houses and Buildings 房屋与建筑

phrases.example: Pochi is upstairs. Go and get him.
phrases.example_zh: Pochi在楼上，去叫他下来。

phrases.example: I've been thinking about buying a condominium. What do you think?
phrases.example_zh: 我一直在考虑买套公寓，你觉得呢？

phrases.example: My apartment is made with reinforced concrete.
phrases.example_zh: 我的公寓是钢筋混凝土结构的。

phrases.example: Did you lock up the back door? There are a lot of thieves out there these days.
phrases.example_zh: 你锁好后门了吗？最近外面小偷很多。

lines.en: Is this your new apartment? It's spacious!
lines.zh: 这是你的新公寓吗？真宽敞！

lines.en: Yes, it's a three-story building with a nice backyard.
lines.zh: 对，是栋带漂亮后院的三层楼。

lines.en: Do you live with your family?
Just me and my cat. The reinforced concrete walls keep it quiet.
lines.zh: 就我和我的猫。钢筋混凝土墙隔音很好。

lines.en: Where's the mailbox?
It's by the front door.

phrases.example: I prefer loafers to oxfords. Loafers are easier to put on.
phrases.example_zh: 比起牛津鞋我更喜欢乐福鞋，乐福鞋更好穿。

phrases.example: Usually I wear flats when I go shopping.
phrases.example_zh: 逛街时我通常穿平底鞋。

phrases.example: The shoehorn is beside the shoe cabinet. Use it if you like.
phrases.example_zh: 鞋拔在鞋柜旁边，需要的话用吧。

lines.en: These loafers are comfortable.
I prefer them to oxfords too.
lines.zh: 我也比牛津鞋更喜欢它们。

lines.en: How do you keep them so clean?
I use the shoehorn and a soft brush.
I should tie my shoelaces tighter.
Mine always come untied too.

scenes.scene: Going to School or Work 上学/上班

phrases.example: My apartment is a 15-minute walk from the station.
phrases.example_zh: 我家离车站步行15分钟。

phrases.example: Rushing out of my apartment, I bumped into the super.
phrases.example_zh: 我冲出公寓时撞上了管理员。

phrases.english: put up an umbrella while riding a bike
phrases.example: Don't put up your umbrella while riding a bike. It's dangerous.
phrases.example_zh: 骑自行车时不要撑伞，很危险。

lines.en: I'm late for school! I have to hurry.
lines.zh: 我上学要迟到了！我得赶紧。

lines.en: Don't run down the stairs.
Yes, mom. How's the weather today?
lines.zh: 好的，妈。今天天气怎么样？

lines.en: It's raining a little, so carry your umbrella with you.
OK. But I think a raincoat would be better because I'm going to school by bike today.
lines.zh: 好。不过我想穿雨衣更好，因为我今天骑车上学。

lines.en: Right. Putting up an umbrella while riding a bike is dangerous. What about rain boots?
lines.zh: 对。骑车撑伞很危险。雨靴呢？

lines.en: No, thank you. Sneakers are fine.
lines.zh: 不用了，谢谢。运动鞋就行。

lines.en: All right. You should get up earlier so you don't have to rush out of the house tomorrow.
lines.zh: 好吧。你该早点起，明天就不用冲出家门了。

phrases.example: Look who it is through the peephole before opening the door.
phrases.example_zh: 开门前先通过猫眼看看是谁。

lines.en: Someone's at the door.
Let me check the peephole first.
Who is it?
It's the neighbor. He dropped by to say hello.
lines.zh: 是邻居，他顺道来打招呼。

lines.en: Invite him in.
Sure, I'll open the door.

phrases.example: Will you take Pochi out for a walk?
phrases.example_zh: 你能带Pochi去散个步吗？

phrases.example: I said hello to my neighbor over the hedge this morning.
phrases.example_zh: 今天早上我隔着树篱和邻居打了招呼。

phrases.example: I have 20 tropical fish in a tank in the living room.
phrases.example_zh: 客厅的鱼缸里养了20条热带鱼。

lines.en: Your backyard looks great.
Thanks. I water the garden every morning.
lines.zh: 谢谢。我每天早晨浇花园。

lines.en: What about the hedge?
I trim it on weekends.
And the turtle?
He's in the small pond by the ground.

phrases.example: Look! The morning glories in the flowerpots are budding.
phrases.example_zh: 看！花盆里的牵牛花正在含苞待放。

lines.en: These flowers are beautiful.
They're just budding. Wait till summer.
Do you use fertilizer?
Only organic. I pull out the weeds by hand.
lines.zh: 只用有机肥，我用手拔草。

lines.en: The hose makes it easy, right?
Yes, the watering can is for the pots.
lines.zh: 对，浇水壶是浇盆栽用的。

phrases.example: Wait at the west exit. I'll pick you up.
phrases.example_zh: 在西出口等我，我去接你。

phrases.english: buy a newspaper at the kiosk
phrases.example: I sometimes buy a sports paper at that kiosk.
phrases.example_zh: 我有时在那家书报亭买体育报纸。

phrases.example: Let's check the timetable to see how often trains come.
phrases.example_zh: 我们查下时刻表，看看火车多久一班。

lines.en: Which platform is the train?
It leaves from the concourse, track 4.
lines.zh: 从中央大厅4号轨道发车。

lines.en: Is there a waiting room?
Yes, near the information desk.
I'll buy a newspaper at the kiosk.
Hurry, the departure is on time today.

phrases.example: Oops! I got stopped by the turnstile.
phrases.example_zh: 哎呀！我被闸机拦住了。

phrases.example: This pass has expired.
phrases.example_zh: 这张通行证过期了。

phrases.example: Wait, I need to adjust fares before passing through the turnstile.
phrases.example_zh: 等等，我需要在过闸机前补票。

phrases.example: How much is the fare to 5th Avenue?
phrases.example_zh: 到第五大道车费多少？

lines.en: Excuse me, where's the ticket machine?
Over there, by the bench.
My pass expired yesterday.
Then adjust fares at the office.
How much to downtown?
Check the fare card reader.

scenes.scene: On the Train 在火车上

vocab.english: put one's bag on the rack
vocab.phonetic: pʊt wənz bæg ɔn ðə ræk

phrases.english: get off at the next stop
phrases.example: Sit here. I'm getting off at the next stop.
phrases.example_zh: 坐这儿，我下一站下车。

lines.en: Do you know how to get to the Central Hospital?
lines.zh: 你知道怎么去中心医院吗？

lines.en: Yeah. First, we'll take an express train to Eastbridge, and change to the Orange Line there.
lines.zh: 知道。我们先坐特快列车到东桥，在那换橙线。

lines.en: And after that?
When we arrive at Northend, we'll take a municipal bus the rest of the way.
lines.zh: 到北端后，剩下的路我们坐市营公交。

lines.en: OK. And how long will it take?
Usually it takes about 35 minutes, but today is Sunday, so we'll have to allow at least 50 minutes.
lines.zh: 通常约35分钟，但今天是周日，至少得留50分钟。

lines.en: We have enough time anyway. Why don't we get something to eat at that kiosk over there?
lines.zh: 反正时间够。我们去那边书报亭买点吃的怎么样？

lines.en: That's a great idea. Let's go.

scenes.scene: On the Train (states) 列车上的状态

phrases.example: I'm tired of getting crushed on the train every morning.
phrases.example_zh: 我厌倦了每天早上在车上被挤。

phrases.example: Someone stepped on my foot but I didn't see who it was.
phrases.example_zh: 有人踩了我的脚，但我没看清是谁。

phrases.example: Oh, no! That guy is trying to molest a woman.
phrases.example_zh: 糟了！那个男的在骚扰一个女的。

lines.en: It's so crowded today.
I got crushed near the door.
Someone stepped on my foot!
Watch out for pickpockets too.
I'll just doze off till my stop.
Don't sleep past your station!

phrases.example: We'd better switch to a rapid train at the next station.
phrases.example_zh: 我们最好在下一站换乘快车。

phrases.example: I sometimes sleep past my station when I'm tired.
phrases.example_zh: 累的时候我有时会坐过站。

phrases.example: What time does the last train leave?
phrases.example_zh: 末班车几点发车？

lines.en: Is this the express to the terminal?
lines.zh: 这是到终点站的特快吗？

lines.en: No, that's the local train stopping at every station.
lines.zh: 不是，那是每站都停的普通车。

lines.en: I need the inbound line.
Transfer at the next station.
Will I make it?
The next stop is yours.

phrases.example: Every bus starts from the depot over there.
phrases.example_zh: 每辆车都从那边的车库发出。

lines.en: Should we take the bus or a taxi?
The bus route map says it's two stops.
lines.zh: 公交线路图说两站就到。

lines.en: But it's raining.
Then a taxi is faster.
Press stop requested, please.
Sure, I'll signal the driver.
Nice SUV. Is it yours?
Yes, a full-size car for the family.
The headlights are bright.
The taillights work too. Look.
Do you use the turn signal?
Always, for safety.
Adjust the rear-view mirror, please.
And the side-view mirror?
Yes. Now fasten your seat belt.
Done. The dashboard looks new.
Start the engine when ready.
Okay, releasing the emergency brake.

phrases.example: Hold the steering wheel tight when you drive.
phrases.example_zh: 开车时握紧方向盘。

phrases.example: Don't forget to release the emergency brake before getting the car started.
phrases.example_zh: 发动车前别忘了松手刹。

phrases.example: This is an automatic car and it rarely stalls.
phrases.example_zh: 这是自动挡车，很少熄火。

phrases.example: I changed lanes and slowed down.
phrases.example_zh: 我变道并减速。

lines.en: Want me to drive?
Sure, get behind the wheel.
Should I speed up?
No, slow down here.
The light is red, wait for it.
And watch the crosswalk.

vocab.english: park the car in the garage
vocab.phonetic: pɑrk ðə kɑr ɪn ðə gərɑʒ

vocab.english: take the car out of the garage
vocab.phonetic: teɪk ðə kɑr aʊt əv ðə gərɑʒ

phrases.example: Pull over here. That's where I want to shop.
phrases.example_zh: 在这靠边停，我要去那家店。

phrases.example: Is there any space for me in the parking lot?
phrases.example_zh: 停车场还有位置给我吗？

lines.en: Turn left here?
No, go straight then make a U-turn.
Is parking allowed?
No, that's illegal parking. Get a permit.
lines.zh: 不能，那是违规停车，要办许可。

lines.en: I'll park in the garage.
Good, then take the car out later.
lines.zh: 好，待会儿再把车开出来。

phrases.example: Wow, this road is so bumpy I might bite my tongue.
phrases.example_zh: 哇，这条路太颠了，我都要咬到舌头了。

phrases.example: There was road construction so I had to take a detour.
phrases.example_zh: 路上在施工，我只好绕道。

phrases.example: When you're riding a bike, watch out for pedestrians walking on the sidewalk.
phrases.example_zh: 骑车时要小心在人行道上走的行人。

phrases.example: It took longer than usual to get to my office because of the traffic jam.
phrases.example_zh: 因为堵车，我到办公室比平时久。

lines.en: Hey, what a traffic jam! We're stuck here. Was there a traffic accident or something?
lines.zh: 嘿，好堵！我们卡住了。是出交通事故了吗？

lines.en: Gee, I have no idea, but actually there was one at this intersection last week.
lines.zh: 哎呀，我不知道，不过上周这个路口确实出过一起。

lines.en: Really? What happened?
An SUV speeding in the passing lane bumped into the guardrail.
lines.zh: 一辆SUV在超车道飙车，撞上了护栏。

lines.en: Wow! Was the driver all right?
Fortunately, he was OK. Anyway, what should we do now?
lines.zh: 还好他没事。那我们现在怎么办？

lines.en: Take a detour at the next corner?
That sounds good.

scenes.scene: Gas Station & Driver's License 加油站与驾照

phrases.example: We should go to a gas station before we run out of gas.
phrases.example_zh: 我们应该在没油前去加油站。

phrases.example: Fill it up and check the oil, please.
phrases.example_zh: 加满，并检查一下机油，谢谢。

phrases.example: I got a flat tire on the way so I was late for work.
phrases.example_zh: 路上爆胎了，所以我上班迟到。

phrases.example: Show me your driver's license, will you?
phrases.example_zh: 出示一下你的驾照，好吗？

lines.en: The tank is empty.
Let's fill it up at the station.
Unleaded or high octane?
Unleaded is fine.
Do you have a spare tire?
Yes, in case we get a flat tire.

chapters.chapter: Chapter 3 At the Office or School 在办公室/学校

vocab.english: take the elevator to the eighth floor
vocab.phonetic: teɪk ðə ˈɛləˌveɪtər tɪ ðə eɪθ flɔr

lines.en: You're cutting it close again.
I know. Let me punch the time clock before the bell.
Take the elevator to the eighth floor with me.
lines.zh: 和我一起乘电梯到八楼。

lines.en: Sure. The revolving door nearly got me today.
lines.zh: 好。今天旋转门差点夹到我。

lines.en: Change into your uniform first, will you?
Right, I'll be quick.

scenes.scene: 办公室·吸烟区与文件柜 Office Area

lines.en: Where do we keep the manuscript?
In the file cabinet, top drawer.
Should I shred these old documents?
Yes, and put the brochures on the shelf.
The safe is locked, by the way.
I'll ask the boss for the key.
Can I borrow a stapler?
Sure. There's a rubber band and some paper clips too.
lines.zh: 可以，还有橡皮筋和回形针。

lines.en: I also need a highlighter.
Use the red one. The correction fluid is over there.
lines.zh: 用红色的，修正液在那边。

lines.en: Thanks. I'll return the tape later.
No rush.

phrases.english: get caught in the revolving door
phrases.example: As I was in a rush, I nearly got caught in the revolving door.
phrases.example_zh: 我赶时间，差点被旋转门夹到。

phrases.english: working overtime day in and day out
phrases.example: I can't take working overtime day in and day out!
phrases.example_zh: 我受不了天天加班！

phrases.example: I usually have the daily lunch special at the cafeteria.
phrases.example_zh: 我通常在食堂吃每日特餐。

phrases.example: Will you staple these papers together after sorting them out?
phrases.example_zh: 你能把这些文件分类后订在一起吗？

phrases.english: put up a poster with tape
phrases.example: Put up the poster with tape, not with pushpins.
phrases.example_zh: 用胶带贴海报，别用图钉。

phrases.example: Let's get down to work right away. We can't waste time.
phrases.example_zh: 我们马上开始工作吧，不能浪费时间。

phrases.example: Exchanging business cards is an important part of doing business.
phrases.example_zh: 交换名片是做生意的重要一环。

phrases.example: I'd like to make an appointment with Mr. Johnson.
phrases.example_zh: 我想和约翰逊先生约个时间。

phrases.example: I want the goods immediately. How long does shipment take?
phrases.example_zh: 我要货很急，发货要多久？

lines.en: I'm going on a business trip next week.
Have you confirmed your schedule?
Not yet. I need to place an order first.
Then file the paperwork with the accountant.
Right, and keep in touch with the client.
lines.zh: 对，还要和客户保持联系。

lines.en: I'll exchange business cards for you.

scenes.scene: 复印机与电话 Copier & Phone

vocab.chinese: 这份复印件太亮了/暗了

phrases.example: Gee, this copier is jammed up again!
phrases.example_zh: 哎呀，复印机又卡纸了！

phrases.english: put me through to the person in charge
phrases.example: Will you put me through to the person in charge?
phrases.example_zh: 能帮我接到负责人吗？

phrases.english: set one's cell phone to manner mode
phrases.example: You must set your cell phone to manner mode during the meeting.
phrases.example_zh: 开会时你必须把手机设为静音模式。

lines.en: Not again!
What?
The copier's jammed again. This is the third time this week.
lines.zh: 复印机又卡纸了，这周第三次了。

lines.en: Well, it just happens. Last time I used it, I had to refill the toner, and it took a lot of time. How many copies do you need to make?
lines.zh: 唉，常有的事。上次我用的时候还得加碳粉，花了好久。你要印多少份？

lines.en: Fifty or so.
How about trying the one downstairs? It can crank out 70 copies a minute.
lines.zh: 要不试试楼下的那台？它一分钟能印70份。

vocab.chinese: 在可录式光盘中刻录数据

phrases.example: My computer often freezes up. Maybe it's time to replace it.
phrases.example_zh: 我的电脑经常死机，也许该换了。

phrases.example: Just in case, backup that file.
phrases.example_zh: 以防万一，把那个文件备份一下。

lines.en: The computer crashed again!
Save the file first, then shut it down.
I already lost my data.
Didn't you backup yesterday?
No. The system administrator will be mad.
lines.zh: 没。系统管理员要发火了。

lines.en: Let's input it again on the laptop.
lines.zh: 我们用笔记本重新录入吧。

phrases.english: a large turnout at the convention
phrases.example: There was a large turnout at the convention.
phrases.example_zh: 那次大会出席的人很多。

phrases.example: Before I start, I'm going to pass around some handouts.
phrases.example_zh: 开始前我先发一些资料。

phrases.english: make a presentation before an audience
phrases.example: I'm making a presentation before a large audience tomorrow. I'm nervous.
phrases.example_zh: 明天我要在很多听众面前演示，好紧张。

phrases.english: who is in charge of the project
phrases.example: Who is in charge of the project?
phrases.example_zh: 谁负责这个项目？

phrases.example: During the meeting I came up with an interesting idea.
phrases.example_zh: 开会时我想到一个有趣的主意。

lines.en: I guess we can get started. First, let me make sure I understand the overall picture of the meeting next Monday. Who will lead the meeting, Lisa?
lines.zh: 我想我们可以开始了。首先我要确认一下下周一会议的全局情况。谁来主持会议，丽莎？

lines.en: Well, that will be John. I think he is well-qualified to be the chairman.
lines.zh: 嗯，是约翰。我觉得他很有资格当主席。

lines.en: Oh, right. But he was just assigned to this section six months ago; I'm afraid this job will be too much for him.
lines.zh: 哦对。但他六个月前才调到这个组，我担心这活对他来说太重了。

lines.en: I will support him. I'll have nothing special to do after I make my presentation.
lines.zh: 我会支持他。我做完演示后就没别的事了。

lines.en: OK. Have you prepared for it?
Oh, sure. Would you like to see what I've prepared?
lines.zh: 当然。你想看看我准备的吗？

lines.en: Sure. Will you use the projector?
Yes, there are many graphs to show.

vocab.chinese: 作总结性声明；使圆满结束
今天到此结束；到此为止

lines.en: Your pie chart is clear.
Thanks. I'll point out the pros and cons.
Can you explain this figure?
Sure. The bar graph shows the trend.
lines.zh: 可以，条形图显示了趋势。

lines.en: Let's wrap up and reach a conclusion.
lines.zh: 我们总结一下，得出结论。

lines.en: Good. I'll emphasize the key point.

phrases.english: wrap up what we talked about
phrases.example: Let me wrap up what we talked about today.
phrases.example_zh: 我来总结一下今天讨论的内容。

phrases.english: be singled out for the position
phrases.example: He was singled out from 34 applicants for the position.
phrases.example_zh: 他从34名应聘者中被选出来担任该职位。

phrases.english: send one's résumé before an interview
phrases.example: Send your résumé before having an interview.
phrases.example_zh: 面试前先把简历发过去。

phrases.example: How is your job hunt coming along?
phrases.example_zh: 你求职进展如何？

phrases.example: You got promoted to general manager?
phrases.example_zh: 你升任总经理了？

phrases.example: We have only a few female office workers in this building.
phrases.example_zh: 这栋楼里我们只有几名女职员。

lines.en: You're well-qualified for this job.
Thank you. I submitted my resignation this morning.
lines.zh: 谢谢，我今天早上提交了辞呈。

lines.en: When can you start?
After I'm assigned to the new section.
If not, we may hire someone else.
lines.zh: 不然我们可能另聘他人。

lines.en: I won't be late, I promise.

phrases.english: be transferred to an overseas branch
phrases.example: Mr. Inoue was transferred from headquarters to an overseas branch.
phrases.example_zh: 井上先生从总部调到了海外分公司。

phrases.example: I want to get into a foreign company, as I'm good at English.
phrases.example_zh: 我想进外企，因为我英语好。

phrases.english: the store is full of customers
phrases.example: That store is always full of customers. I wonder what's on sale today.
phrases.example_zh: 那家店总是挤满顾客，今天不知在搞什么促销。

phrases.example: I can't get along with my new colleagues since being assigned to this department.
phrases.example_zh: 调到这个部门后，我和新同事处不来。

lines.en: Our competitor launched a new product.
lines.zh: 竞争对手推出了新产品。

lines.en: We should ship ours from the factory soon.
Does the subsidiary handle sales?
Yes, through their retailer network.
Tell the supplier to restock.
On it. The wholesaler is ready.
lines.zh: 这就办，批发商准备好了。

vocab.chinese: 经理主管人员；高级官员

lines.en: The Stockholders Meeting is next month.
The chairman and president will attend.
lines.zh: 董事长和总裁都会出席。

lines.en: What's on the agenda?
A merger and a new investment.
lines.zh: 一项并购和一笔新投资。

lines.en: The Board of Directors must approve.
Legal and Audit will review it.
Which department are you in?
Sales, under the manager.
My colleague is in Personnel.
We often work with Logistics.
The secretary handles our schedule.
And Quality Control checks everything.
lines.zh: 质量管理部负责检查一切。

phrases.english: hang around in the student union
phrases.example: We often hang around in the student union unless we have a class.
phrases.example_zh: 没课的时候我们常在学生会晃悠。

phrases.example: Though he lives on campus, he sometimes is late for first period.
phrases.example_zh: 虽然他住校，有时第一节课还是会迟到。

phrases.example: I often look at the bulletin board to see if any classes are cancelled.
phrases.example_zh: 我常看公告栏，看有没有课被取消。

phrases.english: become a member of a club
phrases.example: When I was a freshman, I became a member of a tennis club.
phrases.example_zh: 大一的时候我加入了网球社。

phrases.example: You need your student ID to get a student discount.
phrases.example_zh: 要学生证才能享受学生折扣。

lines.en: Will you help me decide what course to take?
lines.zh: 你能帮我决定选什么课吗？

lines.en: Oh, sure. What do you want to know?
Well, I need four credits to graduate, and I'm thinking about taking Prof. Smith's course this semester. Have you heard anything about that course?
lines.zh: 嗯，我毕业还需要四个学分，这学期在考虑选史密斯教授的课。你听过这门课吗？

lines.en: Actually, I took his course last semester. It was demanding and I had to write lots of papers.
lines.zh: 其实我上学期选过。课很硬，要写很多论文。

lines.en: Wow, that sounds tough. Did you get a good grade?
lines.zh: 哇，听起来好难。你成绩好吗？

lines.en: Yeah. I got an A. I don't want to brag about it, though.
lines.zh: 嗯，我拿了A。不过不想炫耀啦。

lines.en: Good for you. But I don't think I can handle that class. I should take a different course.
lines.zh: 真厉害。但我怕吃不消，还是选别的课吧。

lines.en: Why don't you ask our academic advisor? I'm sure he can help you.
lines.zh: 你去问问学业导师吧，他肯定能帮你。

lines.en: The blackboard is full.
Use the eraser and clean it.
Where's the chalk?
In the locker by the platform.
The teacher pointed to the board.
Write the answer on it, please.
The graduation ceremony is next week.
I'll get my diploma then.
Are you a bachelor or master?
Master. My advisor is a professor.
Don't forget your transcript.
The registrar's office has it.

phrases.example: I need eight more credits to graduate. I wonder if I can make it.
phrases.example_zh: 我还需要8个学分才能毕业，不知行不行。

phrases.example: Mr. Hayes, may I audit your class? I'm interested.
phrases.example_zh: 海斯老师，我能旁听您的课吗？我很感兴趣。

phrases.example: How many courses did you register for this semester?
phrases.example_zh: 这学期你选了几门课？

phrases.example: Don't forget to review what you learned today.
phrases.example_zh: 别忘了复习今天学的内容。

phrases.example: I have to ask someone if I can share their textbook.
phrases.example_zh: 我得问问能不能和谁合用课本。

lines.en: Stand up when the teacher enters.
I was tardy for class again.
Take out your textbook and notebook.
I'll take notes, don't worry.
Don't cut class this time.
I'll stay till the bell.

vocab.english: take a year off from school
vocab.phonetic: teɪk ə jɪr ɔf frəm skul

phrases.example: When is this term paper due?
phrases.example_zh: 这份学期论文什么时候交？

phrases.english: the midterm is near at hand
phrases.example: The midterm is near at hand.
phrases.example_zh: 期中考试临近了。

phrases.example: I have to cram for it.
phrases.example_zh: 我得临时抱佛脚备考。

phrases.example: Look! I got an A in English.
phrases.example_zh: 看！我英语拿了A。

phrases.example: According to the course syllabus, grading will be based on attendance.
phrases.example_zh: 按课程大纲，成绩按出勤评定。

phrases.example: My major is psychology.
phrases.example_zh: 我主修心理学。

phrases.example: The midterm is near, so I have to cram for it.
phrases.example_zh: 期中快到了，我得突击复习。

lines.en: The final exam is coming.
I have to cram for it.
Don't cheat, and no crib sheet.
I just want to ace it.
If you fail, you can make up.
I'd rather not drop out.
What's your major?
Chemistry, with a minor in biology.
I take differential calculus this term.
The syllabus lists integral calculus too.
Physical education is my favorite.
Mine is music, honestly.
